name: hydra-ipad
description: iPad-first visual editors for the Hydra livecoding video synth: shared core, installable shell, test harness.

scripts.test: npm run test -w @hydra-ipad/core && npm run test -w hydra-motion && node scripts/sync-motion.mjs --check && npm run test -w @hydra-ipad/kit -w stack -w graph -w blocks -w rack
scripts.build:motion: npm run build -w hydra-motion && node scripts/sync-motion.mjs
